column1: · An instrument in its entirety is classified as valued using significant unobservable inputs if, in the opinion of management,a significant proportion of the instrument's inception profit or greater than 5% of the instrument's valuation is driven by unobservable inputs 'Unobservable' in this context means that there is little or no current market data
